data.name: Summoning: Jade
data.description: Summon a beautiful but fierce warrior to the battlefield
data.battleDescription: %user creates a cocoon made of crystal, out of it a beautiful warrior appears

data.name: Kōsai Shippū
data.description: Enhances speed and generates crystal-laced shockwaves.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes crystal shockwaves at %target, striking with speed and recoiling damage.

data.name: Prism
data.description: Channel the light from the sun to enlighten the battlefield
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a blinding prism of light, striking %target dealing a devastating blow leaving them wounded.

data.name: Crystal Sphere
data.description: Create a Sphere in which you protect yourself from all damage
data.battleDescription: %user encases themselves in a sphere made of pure crystal

data.name: Crystal Cave
data.description: Create a cave made of Crystals to trap your target
data.battleDescription: %user summons jagged crystals to impale %target, reducing their attack power and increasing the damage they take.

data.name: Crystal Essence
data.description:
In the hidden journey of the Void, deep within Seichi, young Aria discovered ancient, luminous crystals. These weren’t mere stones. They pulsed with energy and stories whispered that they once belonged to celestial warriors. When her village faced the menace of dark entities, Aria felt the crystals resonate with her spirit and she offered up her blood to fuse with them. Guided by age-old manuscripts, she learned to harness their power and to this day, the secrets of her teachings guide those who wish to make the crystallized bond.

Those fortunate enough to possess this bloodline are renowned for their expert mastery of crystals, fire, and earth. They stand as protectors of a celestial legacy, wielding their powers to safeguard the balance between realms and uphold the celestial order.

data.name: Shattered Reflection
data.description: Reflects light to create clones and distort perception.
data.battleDescription: With a flicker of their eyes, %user manipulates the surrounding light, creating multiple afterimages of themselves that confuse and disorient %target. These illusions mirror %target's attacks back at them, leaving them unsure of the true %user's position. Each reflection seems real until %target is struck by a precise blow from the shadows, capitalizing on their disoriented state.

data.name: Lux
data.description: An orb of light that explodes upon impact.
data.battleDescription: %user creates an orb in the palm of one hand. Within the orb, small lights of multiple colors begin to form. As the orb grows, the lights brighten until four translucent rings appear around it. In an instant, %user appears in front of %target and strikes them in the chest with the orb. Upon impact, the orb explodes, and the translucent rings begin to tear %target apart.

data.name: illuminance
data.description: A forbidden technique passed down through the generations. Illuminate the entire battlefield.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a jutsu formula  that spreads out from their feet. Acting as a honing signal, a bright pattern appears above %target . The chakra condenses and beams of light fire towards %target

data.name: Chrono Stasis
data.description: Distort time around an enemy, leaving them more vulnerable to incoming damage while accelerating your own movement through the altered flow.
data.battleDescription: %user traps %target within a large translucent sphere of distorted time. The stasis leaves %target increasingly vulnerable while %user moves through the altered flow with accelerated timing.

data.name: Imperial Swords
data.description: Conjure mirrors and reflect rays of light to pierce your target.
data.battleDescription: %user traps %target within a dense dome made of mirrors. Appearing above the dome, %user clasps their hands together, causing the mirrors to vibrate and swords of light to fire from them toward %target. Trapped in the middle, %target is unable to evade the barrage of swords.

data.name: Eyes of the Forsaken King
data.description:
Long ago, before Shinobi walked the land, a family with extremely potent chakra existed. Rumored to have mingled with beings from the stars, they could control the flow of light and bend it to their will. The members of this family possessed unparalleled power, marked by their unique ability to manipulate light.



When the young heir became King, he was betrayed by his own family, who coveted his potent chakra. On the night of the attack, the King fought valiantly but was overwhelmed. With his dying breath, he plucked his own eyes out and sealed his powers within them. These eyes, known as the Eyes of the Forsaken King, hold the ability to manipulate light, making their bearers both revered and feared.



This is an S-rank bloodline and CANNOT be purchased directly

data.name: Event Horizon Gate
data.description: By manifesting a heavy pool of black chakra, the user twists gravitational pull around their physical body. Hostile impacts are drastically slowed down while stray elements are vacuumed cleanly away.
data.battleDescription: %user erects a dense threshold of bones, increasing their attacking output.

data.name: Godstorm Mantle: Storm-God's Heart
data.description: Tapping into the ragged cries of the storm god that Aegis once heard, the user channels that pure grief into a spiraling vortex of purple lightning. The resulting atmospheric detonation leaves targets vulnerable to all incoming elements.

effects.description: The storm god's cry detonates as violet lightning.
The blast leaves the target cracked open to follow-up force.

data.battleDescription: %user raises a hand as mournful thunder answers, weaving the Storm God’s grief into a mantle of violet lightning. The tempest erupts around %target, its crackling arcs shattering their defenses before detonating in a radiant eclipse of thunder.

data.name: Godstorm Mantle: Heavenbreaker Verdict
data.description: The user parts the clouds above, unleashing a colossal beam of pure storm pressure down a direct line. This linear surge completely ignores defensive measures and scatters the target's offensive focus.

effects.description: The verdict tears through guard and armor.
The storm breaks the target's offensive rhythm.

data.battleDescription: %user tears open the stormbound heavens as pressure condenses into a colossal pillar of violet lightning. The beam crashes down in a flawless line, piercing defenses and striking %target with verdict-like force that breaks their offensive rhythm and weakens their attacks.

data.name: Godstorm Mantle: Raijin's Cage
data.description: The user calls down massive pillars of violet electricity to trap an opponent inside a localized lightning matrix. This oppressive cage crushes the target under immense barometric pressure, locking away their bloodline mechanics.

effects.description: A thunder prison crushes the target.
Thunder pressure arrests the target's movement.

data.battleDescription: %user calls down towering pillars of violet lightning as the battlefield fractures into a sealed storm matrix around %target. The Raijin’s Cage compresses inward with crushing barometric pressure, striking them with relentless arcs that lock their movements and suppress their bloodline flow beneath oppressive electrical confinement.

data.name: Godstorm Mantle: Tempest
data.description: The violet electricity surrounding the user intensifies into a predatory storm mantle, empowering their attacks while draining vitality from enemies caught in its lingering current.

effects.description: The shell reflects part of incoming damage.
The shell scatters hostile effects before they settle.

data.battleDescription: %user condenses violet lightning into a raging storm mantle. The current lashes %target, lingers beneath their skin, and draws stolen vitality back to %user as the storm amplifies %user_subject next attacks.

data.name: Godstorm Mantle: Sky-Splitting Wall
data.description: The user calls upon a localized gale of howling wind and electric sparks. The storm empowers their attacks, disrupts hostile effects, and leaves the target vulnerable to further damage.

effects.description: A storm wall locks around the bearer.
The wall rebounds part of the incoming force.

data.battleDescription: %user condenses violet wind and crackling sparks into a focused gale core. The storm amplifies %user's attacks, wards off hostile effects, and exposes %target to greater damage.

data.name: Godstorm Mantle: Thunder-Crowned Bulwark
data.description: Awakening Aegis's mastery over the weather, the user wraps their entire body in crackling violet lightning. This electric mantle forms a dense, pressurized armor layer that shocks away incoming blunt trauma.

effects.description: A violet thunder shield forms around the bearer.
The storm armor drinks incoming force.

data.battleDescription: %user wraps their body in crackling violet lightning as the Thunder-Crowned Bulwark manifests as a dense electric mantle. Incoming damage is absorbed and %user takes reduced damage as the armor stabilizes around them.

data.name: Obsidian Tomb
data.description: Replicating Eclipse’s ultimate act of defense, the user commands solid, black skeletal plates to erupt from their flesh. This armored cage isolates the user entirely, deflecting outside physical and spiritual harm.

effects.description: Obsidian ribs form a heavy skeletal barrier.
The rib sanctuary rejects hostile chakra interference.

data.battleDescription: %user summons obsidian rods that erupt from the ground and crash into %target with crushing force. The impact deals damage and seals %target’s ability to apply buffs.

data.name: Midnight Verdict
data.description: A sharp, blade-thin line of solid shadow flashes horizontally across the battlefield. This dark edge bypasses physical guards entirely, leaving targets paralyzed under the sheer weight of its judgment.

effects.description: The verdict passes through guard and flesh alike.
The target's next movement catches on the black line.

data.battleDescription: %user releases a blade-thin line of condensed shadow that flashes horizontally across the battlefield. The Midnight Verdict bypasses physical defenses, dealing piercing damage and stunning %target under crushing pressure.

data.name: Corona Devourer Palm
data.description: Focus a ring of dense, light-devouring shadow around your hand, strike your opponent’s chest and leave a retaliatory shadow clinging to them.

effects.description: A black corona detonates under the ribs.
The stolen warmth returns to the user's marrow.

data.battleDescription: %user condenses a ring of light-devouring shadow around their hand and drives it into %target’s chest. The impact deals damage and leaves a shadow ring that turns part of %target’s subsequent attacks back on them.

data.name: Marrow Eclipse Mantle
data.description: The user mimics Eclipse's desperate survival instinct, hardening their inner skeleton with liquid-black energy. This dense shroud aggressively knits together open wounds from within the bone marrow.

effects.description: Black marrow knits ruptured flesh shut.
A dim skeletal corona hardens over the user's body.

data.battleDescription: %user hardens their inner skeleton with liquid-black energy, shrouding their body in a marrow-forged mantle. The oppressive aura leaves %target vulnerable to increased damage while reducing the damage %user takes.

data.name: Black Sun Cataract
data.description: Channeling the heavy malice of Eclipse, the user molds obsidian chakra to manifest a collapsed, black sun. Coming from the collapsed star, are bones coated in obsidian that erodes targets chakra network.

effects.description: A collapsed sun of shadow-fire crushes the target.
The eclipse leaves burning cracks in the target's bones.

data.battleDescription: %user forms a collapsed black sun of obsidian chakra that rains jagged bones upon %target. The impact deals damage, poisons %target, and leaves festering wounds that continue to weaken them.

data.name: Godstorm Eclipse
data.description: Godstorm Eclipse was born when Eclipse's black-bone marrow and Aegis's dying storm were forced into one kind soul. One hand carries obsidian skeletal chakra, the other violet thunder. The bearer hardens bone into shadow armor, drinks wounds into marrow, and tears the sky open with the grief of a storm god.

effects.description: Godstorm Eclipse sharpens black-bone strikes and godstorm pressure.

data.name: Celestial Harmony Shield
data.description: Creates a barrier of harmonious sound waves and mystical energy.
data.battleDescription: %user raises their hands gracefully, and a soft, ethereal melody begins to resonate through the air. The sound waves, infused with mystical chakra, form an invisible barrier that shimmers with a faint light. As the melody grows stronger, the barrier solidifies, creating a protective dome around %user. The harmonious vibrations disrupt incoming attacks, dissipating physical blows and nullifying elemental jutsu. The sound waves also have a calming effect, reducing the impact of mental and genjutsu assaults. The shield remains as long as the melody continues, providing %user with a serene, impenetrable defense.

data.name: Foreboding Interlude
data.description: Generate a soundwave that forces your target to kneel before you.
data.battleDescription: %user snaps their fingers causing the chakra in the air to vibrate generating a distinct soundwave isolating them from the battle and clearing their mind

data.name: Frozen Melody
data.description: Freeze your target with a beautiful melody.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a violin made from pure chakra. As each note rings across the battlefield, %target finds themselves unable to move.

data.name: Harmonic Chamber
data.description: Trap your target in a chamber of deadly music.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a great chamber trapping %target inside, while target is busy trying to escape they hear a faint melody turns into a horrifying screech that ruptures %target eardrums leaving them withering in pain.

data.name: Lullaby
data.description: Cloud your enemy's sense of hearing and lure them to their death.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a flute from the bones of their body, by imbuing chakra into the flute they begin to play  a harsh melody that slowly erodes %targets eardrums

data.name: Heavenly Sonata
data.description:
Wrapped in mystery, the origin of the Heavenly Sonata bloodline remains elusive, shrouded in whispers and conjecture.

Rumors abound, suggesting that its members, practitioners of genjutsu, sought to master the melodies that unlock the gates of Yomi. Some even claim they succeeded.

Though the lineage's beginnings remain enigmatic, it is certain that its descendants possess a natural talent for music. They can wield any melody as a deadly weapon, ensnaring their victims within their genjutsu with celestial notes. Additionally, their potent mystical chakra grants them incredible proficiency with the fire, lightning, and Yin-Yang elements.

data.name: Magnetic Pulse Strike
data.description: A powerful Taijutsu strike that generates a magnetic pulse to disorient and damage the opponent.
data.battleDescription: %user gathers their chakra into their fists, charging it with magnetic energy. With a swift and precise movement, they strike %target directly. Upon impact, a shockwave of magnetic force radiates from the point of contact, distorting the magnetic fields around %target. This pulse disrupts their nervous system and balance, making them vulnerable to follow-up attacks.

data.name: Rising Star
data.description: A powerful Houkyuken uppercut.
data.battleDescription: %user gathers their innate powers into their body. At the right moment, %user unleashes their power into a perfect rising uppercut smashing their fist into %target's chin for a devastating blow.

data.name: Morning Star
data.description: Channel ancient chakra to increase the effectiveness of your attack
data.battleDescription: %user takes the Houkyuken stance, vanishing in a blur. In an instant, %target is launched skyward, where %user appears to deliver a relentless flurry of strikes before slamming them back to the ground with crushing force.

data.name: Houkyuken: Magnetic Assignment
data.description: Even your blood can be used as an effective weapon, thanks to your magnetic mastery and the iron in your blood.
data.battleDescription: %user's blood hardens into a crimson steel-fist, glowing with inner power. With a rapid Houkyuken strike, they drive their fist into %target's stomach, forcing them to cough up blood from the devastating impact.

data.name: Houkyu Dance
data.description: The softer style of Houkyuken, which increases their movement and area of reach from their fists and kicks.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a magnetic pulse, entering the Houkyu Dance. Enhanced by perfect awareness and the amplified speed from the magnetic field, %user unleashes a flawlessly coordinated series of devastating strikes upon %target.

data.name: Houkyuken
data.description:
Formulated through decades of blood research, the origin of this bloodline is shrouded in secrecy, concealed within the ancient tomes of the Global ANBU. Unlike other bloodlines, the potency of this lineage does not stem from raw elemental prowess, but rather from its profound connection to Seichi's natural magnetic forces. By delving deep into the mysteries of the earth's magnetic fields, its wielders have unlocked the ability to manipulate the very makeup of their bodies, rendering them as the magnetic focal point of the battlefield.


Yet, despite their formidable abilities, whispers persist among the wise and wary. Some speculate that the true potential of this bloodline remains untapped, its depths yet to be fully plumbed. As such, there lingers a shadow of apprehension, a fear of the day when the Houkyuken may unlock the hidden secrets concealed within their lineage's ancient heritage.

data.name: Glacial Descent: Cocytus
data.description: Disables the enemy with the cold strength of a glacier, decreasing their overall prowess while increasing yours.
data.battleDescription: Glacial Descent is a blizzard-style jutsu unique to the Hyouga Yui bloodline. It summons a tempest of icy winds and snowflakes, engulfing the battlefield in a swirling maelstrom of frost and sapphire hues.

data.name: Nine Hell's Spear
data.description: Nine Hells Spear is the signature damage-dealing jutsu of the Hyouga Yui clan. It channels the frigid essence of Glacier into a spear of ice, capable of piercing through the toughest defenses.
data.battleDescription: As %user calls upon Nine Hells Spear, the air grows frigid. A spear of ice materializes in their hand, gleaming with an otherworldly light. With a swift motion, %user hurls the spear at the opponent, the icy projectile piercing through defenses and leaving behind a trail of frost.

data.name: Cerulean Storm: Avalanche
data.description: Cerulean Storm is a blizzard-style jutsu unique to the Hyouga Yui bloodline. It summons a tempest of icy winds and snowflakes, engulfing the battlefield in a swirling maelstrom of frost and sapphire hues.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes the ruthless power of the Hyouga Yui bloodline, eyes blazing with cold cerulean fury. Palms slam down—the earth shatters and flash-freezes into a vast, deadly ice field of jagged frost and slick mirrors under screaming arctic winds.

data.name: Glacial Shatter: Purgatory
data.description: The user creates a wave of freezing energy that shatters on impact, dealing widespread damage and freezing the surrounding area.
data.battleDescription: As %user invokes Glacial Shatter, a surge of frigid energy erupts. The wave crashes, shattering on impact, freezing the surrounding area and leaving %target trapped in a field of ice and frost, their movements slowed by the biting cold and their chakra consumption increased.

data.name: Glacier's Will
data.description: Tapping into their special chakra a Glacier Shinobi can reinvigorate themselves during battle.
data.battleDescription: As the battle rages, %user channels their unique chakra to invoke Glacier’s Will, enveloping themselves in a surging frosty aura and gleaming Ice Armor that bolsters defenses like an unbreakable glacial shield—fatigue instantly melts away, replaced by razor-sharp focus and renewed vigor. With the awakened fury of the Hyouga Yui bloodline, %user glides and dashes across the frozen terrain with blistering speed, each swift movement amplifying their strikes to deliver surging damage as they close in on foes with unbreakable resilience.

data.name: Hyouga Yui
data.description:
Etched within the ice lies the tale of the origin of Hyouga Yui, a bloodline steeped in the frosty embrace of legend. In the early days of Seichi, when the first ninjas ventured into the Hyuogaan Mountains, Kuraokami, astonished by their audacity, issued them a challenge for his own amusement. He promised to bestow divine knowledge of the ice element upon them if they could endure a night there. The ninja clan of Hyouga Yui, confident and unwavering in determination, accepted the challenge. Kuraokami reveled in anticipation, conjuring an intense snowfall capable of chilling even the lava of a volcano. Contrary to what Kuraokami expected, this did not deter the ninjas. They stood proud throughout the night, showing no signs of pain despite the cold's toll on their bodies.

 

Impressed and surprised by their strength, Kuraokami fulfilled his promise, granting them both knowledge and a natural ability to manipulate the ice element. This gift has been passed down through generations, a testament to the resilience and valor of the Hyouga Yui lineage.
